water.title: Tanning ledge
water.text: A shallow ledge to lounge in a few inches of water.
water.alt: In-water loungers on a tanning ledge, under a white pergola.

water.title: Spillover spa
water.text: Raised above the pool, sharing its equipment.
water.alt: A raised square spa in stacked stone, spilling into the pool.

water.title: Stand-alone spa
water.text: With its own equipment, apart from the pool.
water.alt: A round raised spa in stacked stone with a light coping.

water.title: Deck jets
water.text: Crystal Fountains jets that arc into the pool.
water.alt: Three deck jets arching into a small pool.

water.title: Cascades
water.text: Water features that start right in the coping.
water.alt: A sheet of water falling from a stone wall into the pool.

water.title: Rock waterfalls
water.text: RicoRock waterfalls and boulders to jump from.
water.alt: A stacked rock waterfall pouring into a pool.

water.title: Slides
water.text: S.R. Smith slides, from the Cyclone to the BigRide.
water.alt: A gray pool slide at the edge of a rectangular pool.

around.title: Stamped concrete
around.text: Gray or color, pressed with shells and starfish if you like.
around.alt: Stamped concrete deck with shells and a starfish pressed into it.

around.title: Seashell finish
around.text: Concrete with real shells exposed in the surface.
around.alt: Close-up of seashell-finish concrete with crushed shells in it.

around.title: Coping
around.text: The rounded edge between the water and the deck.
around.alt: Close-up of a rounded coping edge between seashell concrete and pool water.

around.title: Stamped stone
around.text: Concrete stamped in a cut-stone pattern.
around.alt: Concrete deck stamped in a cut-stone pattern.

around.title: Travertine
around.text: Travertine decking and coping, here with stepping stones.
around.alt: A freeform pool with travertine decking and stepping stones set in black pebbles.

around.title: Pavers
around.text: Paver decks and coping in your choice of color.
around.alt: A rectangular pool with a gray paver deck.

around.title: Fences and gates
around.text: Pool barrier compliant, so the pool is closed when you want it to be.
around.alt: A rectangular pool behind a black mesh safety fence.

back.title: Fire pits
back.text: Stone fire pits, with a place for the firewood.
back.alt: A stone fire pit circled by white Adirondack chairs, with a firewood rack behind.

back.title: Fireplaces
back.text: Outdoor stone fireplaces and seating areas.
back.alt: An outdoor stone fireplace with sofas on a stamped concrete patio.

back.title: Outdoor kitchens
back.text: Built-in grills and counters by the pool.
back.alt: An outdoor kitchen with a built-in grill and white cabinets.

back.title: Pergolas
back.text: Shade over the deck, or right over the water.
back.alt: A white pergola beside a rectangular pool.

back.title: Gazebos
back.text: A covered room by the pool.
back.alt: A metal gazebo with sofas and curtains on a concrete deck.

back.title: Outdoor showers
back.text: Rinse off on the way in.
back.alt: An outdoor shower against a brick wall.

back.title: Pool enclosures
back.text: Keep swimming after the weather cools down.
back.alt: A pool inside a screened enclosure.
